title: 2024 HMMT November Theme Problem 6
statement: Let \(F E L D S P A R\) be a regular octagon, and let \(I\) be a point in its interior such that \(\angle F I L=\angle L I D=\) \(\angle D I S=\angle S I A\). Compute \(\angle I A R\) in degrees.

solutions.text:
Observe that \(I\) lies on line \(D R\) due to symmetry, so \(I D \| F L\). Thus \(\angle F L I=\angle L I D=\angle F I L\), implying that triangle \(F I L\) is isosceles with \(F I=F L\). Similarly, \(A I=A S\). Since \(F L S A\) is a square, \(F I=F L=A S=A I=F A\). Therefore, \(F I A\) is equilateral, so \(\angle A I R=\frac{1}{2} \angle F I A=30^{\circ}\) and \(\angle I A R=180^{\circ}-30^{\circ}-\frac{1}{2} \cdot 135^{\circ}=82.5^{\circ}\).
